about: High-abuse TLDs (decision D23, signal 2): display-only, never changes a level (the URL model already reads the TLD). Only the TLD names and their published scores are kept, as cited facts. Commercial use: re-check the source's terms.
source: Interisle Consulting Group, Cybercrime Information Center, 'Phishing Activity in TLDs, May 2026 - July 2026', https://cybercrimeinfocenter.org/phishing-activity-in-tlds-may-july-2026 (retrieved 2026-10-18). Score = phishing domains per 10,000 domains in the zone; TLDs with >= 30,000 domains and >= 25 phishing domains. (c) Interisle Consulting Group, all rights reserved.
